resolved_observability_findings.resolution: All Stage04B LangSmith decorators use compact allowlisted input/output processors; raw MCP tracing was removed and sentinel tests exclude query, plan, messages, evidence, citations, URLs, secrets and generated summaries.
Logs, progress, Sentry and tool errors use stable codes and allowlisted identity/count metadata only; original exceptions and private argument values are never persisted or returned.

Measured compact lifecycle metadata covers provider/search, SEC, Vector, Graph, Hybrid, comprehensive analysis, synthesis and pre-State leakage gates with exact counts, degradation and rejection codes.

Shared State retains ResearchFeatures plus deterministic evidence/citation reference IDs only; citation dictionaries, synthesis text, raw rejection records, exception text and evidence payloads are excluded.

implementation_contract.identity: ForecastContext and run_id are mandatory and manager-authorized ticker/as_of/lookback/dataset/run identity overrides model arguments.
implementation_contract.historical_boundary: Historical execution admits only retained allowlisted archives; unavailable archives return DATA_UNAVAILABLE and never fall back to today's web.
implementation_contract.temporal_safety: SEC filed_at and every evidence timestamp must be on/before as_of; evidence is rejected before synthesis and again before State materialization.
implementation_contract.features: Typed ResearchFeatures carry catalysts, risks, timestamps, deterministic evidence and citation-reference IDs, source diversity, Vector/Graph coverage, missing/degraded flags, dataset version and run identity.
implementation_contract.privacy: Trace, logs, progress, Sentry, MCP failures and State expose stable codes, identities, latency and counts only.
implementation_contract.prompt_rename: propt_search_agent.py was atomically replaced by prompt_research_agent.py with direct imports/exports and collection-safe tests.

leakage_and_privacy_result.trace_and_persistence: Sentinel tests prove raw query, planner/checker text, evidence/citation payload, URL, secret and exception text do not reach processed traces, logs, progress, Sentry, tool errors or compact State slots.
leakage_and_privacy_result.lifecycle: All ten Stage04B boundaries report non-negative measured latency and deterministic counts/codes without payload content.
